gen-gf-turret-road-fs-sentient: Commanding round forms lead here, each like an open parenthesis. Sentient follows in a serif with gentle modulation and pinched apertures, so paragraphs feel contemporary and measured rather than loud.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-karma: Chunky and bent like cable, Underdog hangs a horseshoe c on every word it touches. Karma, a classic serif, keeps its terminals clear and its modulation soft.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-literata: Underdog draws every curve as one plain stripe of ink. Literata sits beneath it as a serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, its rounded letters opening wide, so a page moves from blunt to bookish.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-sentient: Blunt, wide-mouthed and unshaded, Underdog hits hard with strokes that never swell or thin. Sentient's serif strokes modulate gently, with no sharp hairlines to snag.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-bespoke-slab: Unica One has a huge lowercase eye with visible daylight inside every curve, all drawn at a single thickness. Bespoke Slab, a text serif, does the opposite job, offering tall, grounded lowercase bodies that carry the reading.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-erode: Distinctive in its way, Unica One draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, and it commands attention at the top. And Erode, a serif with a gentle ebb and flow of weight, handles the reading below.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-hoover: Hoover, a classic serif, has a generous entry into the e and compressed ascenders. Then Unica One steps in above it, with the plain line of a fixed-width stencil brush and big open curves.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-trench-slab: A very large lowercase eye, open curves and one steady thickness make Unica One unmistakable. Trench Slab, a classic serif, narrows the gap between x-height and caps, and the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-domine: That large lowercase eye in Unica One looks laser-cut, one cutting width all the way through. But Domine brings the mild variation of a gently used dip pen, so making the heading small would waste it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-esteban: Unica One cuts every stroke at one fixed nib width. Esteban, a serif, answers with thin parts only slightly slimmer than its stems and an oversized, wide-open lowercase that never feels squeezed.
